source.title: String C-groups of 2-power order project onto a common string C-group
source.reading_scope: Complete 10-page source previously read; definitions and nondegeneracy footnote on printed pages 2–3, Theorems 1.1–1.2 on page 2, target group on page 4, specified kernel and Theorem 4.2 on pages 5–6 rechecked in this research chain. Third-party source excluded from any public export.

exact_target: Theorems 1.1–1.2, restricted to finite 2-groups of nilpotency class at most four and arbitrary rank d>=2, with the stronger canonical kernel gamma_3(G).
result: For every nondegenerate finite string C-group G of 2-power order and nilpotency class at most four, the induced marked quotient G/gamma_3(G) is the path-cocycle group G(C_d), of order 2^(2d-1) and type {4,...,4}.
method: Exact local class-four commutator table with marked supports
Hypothetical binary edge relation forces selected p and s corrections to vanish inside G
Five exact double-commutator equations move remaining central corrections to opposite sides of every selected cut
Actual subgroup IP separates supports, first killing selected edge squares and then the first selected commutator
Order comparison identifies the canonical quotient; quotient IP follows only after this identification
retained_written_inputs: Burnside basis theorem for finite p-groups
Elementary commutator identities and lower-central weight bounds
The defining string C-group intersection property in the original group
Previously proved path-cocycle model, order and subgroup IP from phase12_path_cocycle.md
not_retained_as_proof_inputs: Intersection property in any lower-central quotient
The source erroneous specified Frattini-intersection kernel conclusions

independent_review.parent_review: Complete written proof reviewed; no gap found; parent will bind separate source-bound review.
independent_review.second_review: Complete written proof and separate universal-quotient diagnostics reviewed by rank_stability; no gap found; independent review artifacts being bound separately.

remaining_work: Nilpotency classes greater than four and the unrestricted Theorems 1.1–1.2 are not settled by this result.
The earlier counterexample to the source specified kernel is not reversed.
No publication-priority assessment, independent external review or complete Lean formalization is claimed.
